title: Playwright MCP safety options
instructions: The crew runs @playwright/mcp 0.0.78 headless for a model-driven browser (special teams). Which command-line options and tools does Playwright MCP document for LIMITING what the browser may do: allowed/blocked origins, allowed hosts, file: access, capabilities (--caps), isolated profiles, output directories, timeouts, and any tool that runs arbitrary code? Quote the documentation. Start at https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp and its README.
